title: Document the supported procedure for coordinators to create root coding sessions via POST /api/sessions, with its recorded contract
outcome: Document the supported procedure for coordinators to create root coding sessions via POST /api/sessions, with its recorded contract
acceptance: A docs/features page (cross-linked both ways with docs/features/agent-delegation-sessions.md and docs/architecture.md) formally documents the root-session API: POST /api/sessions request fields (name, workdir or projectId, agent, model, approvalPolicy, sandboxMode, reasoningEffort, and agent-specific modes), the success response (sessionId, revision, session), and its error and admission behaviour (status codes and bodies for a malformed body, an unknown agent or model, a workdir outside any project), each checked against the code with file:line.

The page states the required coordinator record for every created root: creator, project and cwd, explicit model, purpose or task item, and the creation receipt, written as a tracker note on that item; and the ownership limits: who may create roots, that roots match ready, disjoint packages and host capacity, never unbounded idle capacity; serial gates and landings unchanged; the Sol default and its recorded exceptions.

The page lists the supported routes for creating sessions (the TermAl UI, POST /api/sessions, child delegations via termal_spawn_session) and when to use each, and warns that the TermAl binary must never be run without a known subcommand (w-e5151bf4da18).
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.

completion.summary: Documented and landed the root coding session POST /api/sessions contract, provenance and ownership rules, and supported UI/API/child-delegation routes. Full gate passed 5/5 on the exact committed tree; independent acceptance evaluation 2d2b714164b4457d91ba40d43511d7e5 passed 4/4.
